business_problem: Shengtong Technology needed a way to make industrial inspection models more accurate and easier to adapt across power, mining, and chemical sites without buying large amounts of local GPU infrastructure.
solution_summary: Shengtong Technology used Huawei Cloud and the Pangu mining foundation model to build a layered industrial inspection platform that turns generic AI into site-specific inspection applications. At the base, the company trained a 3-billion-parameter 'Shengtong industrial inspection large model' on top of the Pangu mining model, then produced 700-million-parameter power, coal, and chemical industry models and finally fine-tuned L2 application models for specific customer workflows. Huawei Cloud supplies the integrated train-and-infer development environment, elastic compute, and storage needed to process raw inspection data, run pretraining and fine-tuning, deploy models, and iterate them continuously. This multi-level architecture lets the same stack handle personnel safety, equipment condition, production process, and site-environment inspection while reducing dependence on local GPU hardware and making anomaly recognition more generalizable across industrial sites.

data_flow: Inspection data and images are collected into Huawei Cloud, where the train-and-infer platform processes them for pretraining, industry adaptation, and scenario fine-tuning. The resulting application models are then deployed back into field inspection workflows to identify abnormal people, equipment, process, and environmental conditions.
